sql:
select fish_date_season as season,
  cast(fish_date_doy/15 as int)*15 as doy_bin,
  cls,
  sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers,
  round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) as ypa,
  count(*) as boat_days
from trips
where fish_date_doy between 230 and 335
  and cls in ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','hd_twilight','three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5')
group by 1,2,3
order by 3,1,2

# Notes (season 2, planning turn @ day 244, 21:00)

## Where we stand
Budget $120, PTO 3/10, season_score 0.7021, rank 4/34 (unchanged since day213 planning
turn — zero bookings day176→day244, 68 straight nights of correct "nothing affordable/live"
holds per journal). Leaderboard: skeptic_solo 0.828 (1st), persist_solo 0.721 (2nd),
calendarist 0.705 (3rd), **upweller 0.702 (4th)**, follower 0.668 (5th). Gap to 3rd is only
0.003 — a single decent live-boat flyer could retake rank 3, but budget makes that very
unlikely (see below). S1+S2 are practice, don't count toward cumulative.

## CONFIRMED THIS TURN: the rest of S2 is a dead season, budget-wise — plan accordingly
Queried fleet ypa by class, 15-day doy bins, doy225-330, S1+S2 combined:
- **HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT ($80, the only classes $120 can ever afford): ypa is 0.0000-0.0033
  in EVERY bin from doy225 to doy330, both seasons.** Confirmed season-invariant dead zone,
  now checked across the full fall stretch not just doy154-225.
- **THREE_QUARTER ($150, out of reach at $120): ypa climbs from ~0.007-0.02 (doy225-255) to
  0.137 (doy270), 0.333 (doy285), 0.234 (doy300) in S1.** S2's doy225→240 already shows the
  same early climb (0.008→0.041) — consistent with the day213 finding that S2's wake-up runs
  earlier than S1's.
- **OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 ($400/$550, far out of reach): this is where the real money is.** S1
  day_1_5 ypa: 0.04 (doy240) → 0.08 (doy270) → **2.93 (doy285) → 3.65 (doy300)** — a 40-90x
  jump. Overnight: 0.35→0.17→0.65→**1.63 (doy300)**. This is the single best window of the
  whole season and this budget cannot touch it, confirming the day213 note's #1 S3 priority.
- **Conclusion: at $120/PTO-3, there is no bookable class left this season that has ever
  produced real yellowtail in this doy range, except a rare HD/twilight live-boat blip** (like
  the d164 New Seaforth flyer, 3yt/0.075 share — genuinely rare, not a pattern to expect).
  Season score is very likely locked at ~0.70 unless one such blip appears.

## Standing plan for the nightly self, day244 → season end (~doy334)
1. Keep holding budget/PTO by default. Only spend the $80 HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT flyer when a
   specific boat in tomorrow's offers has a genuine fresh actual (1-2 trips ago, not a stale
   "typical" average) AND ideally falls on a weekend/holiday (no PTO cost) — exactly the
   discipline that's been followed since day176, keep it unchanged.
2. Do not chase THREE_QUARTER/OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 "live signal" mentions in the briefing even
   though they'll look increasingly tempting through doy270-300 (real fleet ypa will be
   climbing per above) — budget physically cannot cover them ($120 < $150 minimum). No amount
   of live-boat conviction overrides an unaffordable price; don't rationalize a partial/wrong
   booking.
3. CUTI/BEUTI stays dropped (confirmed null, day213). SST is background color only.
4. strategy.py stays the no-op placeholder — nothing programmatic to add when the only lever
   left is "is this specific $80 boat's last trip actually >0 yt," which needs live judgment
   each night, not a fixed rule.

## For S3 planning (revised, in priority order)
1. **Hard number from this turn: keep budget above $150 continuously from ~doy180 through at
   least doy300**, and ideally hold $400-550+ in reserve specifically for a doy270-300
   overnight/day_1_5 push — that window is worth 10-40x what THREE_QUARTER ever pays (2.9-3.65
   ypa vs 0.13-0.33 ypa in S1's doy285-300). This is the highest-leverage single fix for S3:
   this season's spring/summer 3Q chasing (12 trips by day182) is what locked the budget at
   $120 and cost the entire fall opportunity.
2. Treat doy180-190 as the earliest point a real wake-up can start (S2 evidence) — don't wait
   for doy266+ to start checking live actuals in 3Q/overnight/day_1_5; start checking at
   doy180 and be ready to act if a season shows an early wake-up like S2 did.
3. HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT dead-zone (ypa ~0.000-0.003) now confirmed across the ENTIRE
   doy154-330 span, both seasons. Never budget for HD as a real strategy, only as an
   occasional free/cheap flyer on a boat with a genuine live actual.
4. CUTI/BEUTI: confirmed no signal at lag 0/7/10/14, drop entirely for S3.
5. Live-actual boat chasing (last 1-2 real trips, not rolling "typical") remains the only
   method that's produced real shares this season (0.136, 0.2, 0.25, 0.075) — keep it as the
   core trigger, just apply it inside a budget that hasn't been pre-spent down by doy180.
6. Concretely for S3: cap total spend through doy180 at roughly $400-500 (leaves $1500+ for
   the doy180-300 window where all the real yield — 3Q climbing, then the day_1_5/overnight
   fall spike — actually lives), rather than the ~$1880/12-trips pace that happened in S2.
